signal: With 16 of 40 comparative systems evidence-bound, the matrix is a testable comparative framework. The remaining 24 are a controlled backlog. The numerator (~43%) is no longer the interesting story.
chain_sentence: Evidence → comparative diagnosis → Arkansas design → legal feasibility → pilot → measurement → expansion.
chain_purpose: The sequence that can eventually turn the research corpus into the 8–16 year Arkansas transition framework (HYP-129) without pretending modeling, legal architecture, or manuscript are complete.

next_wave_focus.item: Finish the shared-dial architecture for all evidence-bound systems
next_wave_focus.rule: Same definitions, time periods, geography rules, and evidence-status language across the 16 bound systems.

next_wave_focus.item: Move HYP-130 from inventory toward an Arkansas capability map
Build HYP-129 into an actual transition/funding architecture

compare_backlog_rule.do_not: Fill remaining systems merely to make the matrix look complete.
compare_backlog_rule.may_bind_when: A written argument already needs the system and existing panels illuminate it without inventing verdicts.

completion_rule.interesting_story: Milestone chain progress, not overall percent inflation

phase3_crosswalk_role: Foundation for comparative diagnosis step; shared-dial architecture is the next finish line before more system binds.
